summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of CEO AI. 21/21 pytest backend tests passed (auth, onboarding, entries incl. CSV AI import, dashboard/snapshot, briefing AI, chat streaming Claude, score, future projection+simulate, memories, settings). Frontend E2E via Playwright: admin login → dashboard renders humano briefing (PT) + health ring + company value + all 7 vitals; ask-CEO navigates to /ceo, chat streams a Claude response; navigation between /financas, /score, /futuro, /definicoes and back works; logout returns to /login. All expected data-testids present across Finances, Score, Future, Settings pages.

issues: Multiple similar memories accumulate on repeated onboarding/DNA save (e.g. '1M em faturação', 'Quer faturar 1000000.0', 'Liberdade financeira'). Not a bug, but consider dedup or replacing 'objetivo' upsert format to avoid double entries when target_revenue and five_year_vision cover the same concept.
Contrast is acceptable in dark mode. In light mode not tested — main agent may verify readability of headline over the background image if light theme is enabled on /login.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS: allow_origins uses explicit FRONTEND_URL from env plus localhost — good. allow_credentials=True is compatible because origin is explicit (not '*').
Auth cookie is httpOnly, secure, samesite=none — correct for cross-origin preview URL.
bcrypt used for password hashing; verify_password swallows exceptions safely.
seed_admin on startup updates password_hash if it differs — idempotent and covers password rotation.
chat streaming uses SSE with 'X-Accel-Buffering: no' header — required for k8s ingress buffering; validated working end-to-end with Claude opus 4.7 provider mapping.
briefing/simulate parse fenced ```json blocks with fallback — safe if AI wraps output; still relies on a single JSON block.
import CSV endpoint feeds up to 6000 chars of raw file to GPT — very large CSVs will be truncated silently; consider chunking or returning a note.
server.py is ~700 lines and mixes routes, helpers, and models — approaching the threshold to split into modules (auth/company/entries/ai) for maintainability, not blocking.
All handlers exclude MongoDB _id from responses correctly.
Settings PUT dereferences settings after update without null-check — after the upsert it will exist, but defensive coding could add a guard.

future_projection uses now.month indexing; with 12 iterations the current month appears both as the starting month and reappears at the 12th step which is expected but might confuse users. Minor UX polish.
test_credentials: obeliscoradical@gmail.com / CeoAI2026! (admin) — validated. Google OAuth not exercised (external redirect), only button presence verified.
seed_data_creation: Company 'TEST_Silva & Filhos' set on admin account; a few TEST_ entries and one TEST_ memory were created and one TEST_ memory removed by tests. Settings changed to ceo_mode=agressivo, briefing_count=5 by TestSettings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows green. If retesting after code changes, note that TestSettings.test_settings_update leaves admin settings with ceo_mode=agressivo/briefing_count=5. Reset via PUT /api/settings if a clean state is required. Chat streaming test uses a short prompt to keep runtime <30s. Frontend E2E should use `wait_for_selector` on data-testids rather than `wait_for_load_state('networkidle')`, because AI streaming keeps the network active.
